stemMd: For nonzero x and y, simplify 12x cubed y squared divided by 3xy.
explanationMd: Divide coefficients to obtain 4, subtract x exponents 3−1=2 and y exponents 2−1=1. The result is 4x squared y.

distractorRationale.a: This fails to cancel one y.
distractorRationale.b: This multiplies coefficients instead of dividing.
